issues.summary: The 1,492 supported cells without matching runtime evidence require individual realtime probes before they can be classified as runtime-passed.
issues.impact: The runtime patch contract can be staged and validated statically, but one Alenger pilot does not prove the remaining maps or commanders.
issues.nextAction: Run the Stage 10 realtime probe per map and commander against an independent approved-launcher window, then index only the passing cell evidence.

issues.summary: Mission-only openings with no CommandCenter/SCV anchor did not initialize the selected commander's base and workers.
issues.impact: The selected commander could load but its declared starting base and worker state was absent on thanson01.
issues.resolution: The staged runtime Galaxy overlay now creates the manifest base and worker count at a P1 mission-unit anchor when no selected starting structure exists. The repaired thanson01 x TerranAlenger3 window observed one base and 12 workers in realtime with no ScriptError.
